items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Two-line change with a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', and it matches the surrounding style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper inside single_alias. No duplicated logic and no dead code. Collector/QuerySet.delete are left alone.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No new error paths or magic constants. get_initial_alias() is idempotent. The agent ran the delete, delete_regress, queries and other test suites, and the hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias by registering the base alias before counting, so joined deletes still count more than one alias and keep the subquery. The MySQL compiler inherits the fix, and there is no backend-specific special case. Identical to the reference.
